description: Send one OpenAI chat completions request to a compatible endpoint, reading an optional Bearer key from --key-env NAME in this process; returns the assistant message, usage and the model that answered. Errors: ArgumentsBad, EndpointFailed, ReplyBad. Agents normally do not call this: their brain goes through the llm kernel (memory brain.json).

key_env.description: environment variable name to read the Bearer key from in this process; optional, no Authorization header if omitted; an unset variable is EndpointFailed

endpoint.description: one endpoint: url (up to /v1), model, fixed (optional fields that override the request); model always comes from here; key is not accepted

request.description: an OpenAI chat completions body without the endpoint: messages required; tools, temperature, model optional
